verdict.tagline: Endless physics sandbox destruction, best enjoyed with careful workshop use.
for_you_if: you want a sandbox that runs smoothly on modest hardware
not_for_you_if: you worry about workshop security risks and malware
you need fresh gameplay variety without relying on mods
you push performance limits with massive explosions

This game is so much fun in my opinion but this game's workshop has a severe lack of security that cant be ignored. There is a new virus for this game's workshop every half year and each one worse than the last. The most recent one deletes all of your steam data for every game and sends every one of your friends racial slurs. Assuming it follows this trend, they'll eventually start deleting deleting your non steam files and atp system 32. its not worth the risk. It such a shame.

This games workshop keeps getting attacked with actual real pc damaging malware multiple times its ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ stupid.

Context edit: There are multiple viruses going around the workshop that do stuff they should NOT be able to do. Like not just some ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ like deleting your mods or stuff like that but like actual malware that escapes the game, drops files, shreds files in multiple directorys, *allegedly* resets all progress you have in all games you have, takes control of your steam account, etc. NO MOD SHOULD BE ABLE TO THAT. Any game with mods should have a custom modding API that gives the mods access to specific systems and functions in the games engine, this game apparently, according to people ive talked to gives mods access to the ENTIRE GAME ENGINE which is extremely unsecure and dangorus. No security
I cant fully blame the devs for this, its not their fault, but you need to fix your modding system
This is the second time its happened and the malware has gotten WAY WAY more advanced the second time, so imagine what it could be if another one is released
Fun game, but the second time a massive virus affected the userbase. Fix your workshop dude. Won't be playing until this stuff gets fixed.

Was a fun game for it's time, and it still probably can be. However, its workshop is turning out to be a vector for malware and it's just not worth the risk to your PC. If you stick with playing completely vanilla, then you don't have to worry, but missing out on all the wonderful content others have put a lot of time and effort into is unfortunate and, frankly, the game really needs them to remain entertaining.

The game itself is fine, but while the Steam Workshop for it remains an avenue for spreading malware I just cannot recommend this to anyone.
